extensionContractKept.description: 1:1 extension of marketplace_creators. Adds: vendor_type (17 physical service categories), location (city/province), lead_time_days, is_available_now, pricing (display-only), whatsapp/instagram contact augmentation, moderation (pending/approved/rejected), is_featured.
Geographic and remote service coverage per vendor profile. New concept — no existing counterpart.
Creative capability tags: material/fashion/interior/graphic capabilities, proficiency levels, tools. New concept — no existing counterpart.
Vendor verification metadata: certifications, licences, industry body memberships. New concept — no existing counterpart.

architectureDecisionsRequired.title: Vendor Rating Storage

options: A: Extend marketplace_ratings with itemType='creative_vendor', itemId=creative_vendor_profiles.id
B: New table creative_vendor_ratings anchored to creative_vendor_profiles.id

architectureDecisionsRequired.title: Vendor Contact / Lead Inquiry Pattern

B: New table ai_vendor_inquiries anchored to marketplace_creators.id
C: Reuse service_request flow as lightweight vendor inquiry

securityNotes: External URLs validated at storage time (SSRF guard: protocol allowlist, private IP block, raw IP block)
Whatsapp masked in public DTO (first 5 chars + *****)
Email masked via marketplace_creators (source of truth)
pageSize capped at 50 (public) / 100 (admin) in service layer
Recommendation candidates capped at 200, results capped at 50
Blocked contact request endpoint preserves security spec for architecture review: rate limit, dedup, terminal state, PII hashing
pricingNote: Pricing fields (min_price, max_price) are display-only in creative_vendor_profiles. NOT connected to any checkout, procurement, payment, or RAB system. Explicitly excluded per specification.

covers: toPublicCard: merged creator + profile DTO (id, profileId, creatorCode, isVerified, avgRating from creator; vendorType, location, operations from profile)
validateExternalUrl: SSRF guard (private IPs, raw IP literals, protocol enforcement)
Portfolio blocked: VendorCanonicalMappingBlockedError thrown by all portfolio functions

Recommendation scoring: category(30) + area(25) + availability(20) + rating(15) + verification(10)
Area matching: province match, remote fallback, no match
N+1 avoidance: single batch select for all service areas
